placements.why: The directives mandate the explicit removal and forgetting of past architectural decisions and technical migration knowledge, establishing an organizational knowledge governance boundary.
placements.title: Operational boundaries governing retention and expungement of organizational knowledge
placements.frame: How does the organization govern the lifecycle, retention, and removal of historical decisions and technical records?

placements.title: Mandating the excision of historical architectural decisions and migration records
placements.frame: When and how are past decisions and technical migration histories formally expunged from organizational memory?
placements.why: Both expressions function as unconditional directives to purge specific historical decisions (Quantum Widget) and migration records (PostgreSQL to QuantumDB) from the knowledge base.
